info.title: TigerSqlCmd .NET Tool
info.description: Modern SQL Server CLI built on TigerQuery for sqlcmd-compatible script execution, saved connection profiles, interactive and non-interactive automation, external-tool handoff, and safe session-scoped E2E database lifecycles.

commands.name: exec
commands.description:
Run an external program against a saved connection, passing it the resolved connection string. The program is
started directly; no shell is involved, so nothing re-parses, expands, or globs the child command line.
Every tiger-sqlcmd option goes before --. Everything after it is the child executable and its arguments, passed
through literally. At least one handoff is required, and both together are allowed:
{connection-string} in any child argument is replaced by the resolved connection string, also inside a larger
argument; all other text is preserved.
--connection-string-env <variable-name> sets that variable to the resolved connection string for the child process
only.
Prefer the environment variable when the child supports it: an argument is visible to anyone who can list
processes on the machine.
tiger-sqlcmd exec -c prod --connection-string-env DB_CONNECTION -- my-tool --report
tiger-sqlcmd exec -c prod -- my-tool --target={connection-string} --report
The child inherits stdin, stdout, stderr, the working directory, and the rest of the environment, and its exit
code is returned unchanged. Exit code 21 means the child could not be started at all.

options.name: --connection
options.description:
Name of a saved SQL Server connection (managed via the 'connection' command).
Required.

options.name: --connection-string-env
options.description:
Set this environment variable to the resolved connection string for the child process only. Preferred over
argument substitution when the child can read it.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Advanced sqlcmd execution: run a script file or query with variables, output routing, mode, verbosity and logging.

options.name: --connection
options.description:
Name of a saved SQL Server connection (managed via the 'connection' command).
Required.

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to the SQL script file to execute.

options.name: --command-timeout
options.description:
Seconds each SQL batch may run before it is cancelled. 0 means no limit; omit for the 30-second provider default.
This is not the connection timeout.

options.name: --output
options.description: Result output: Initial path for routed result sets; :Out can replace it.

options.name: --result-format
options.description:
Result output: Structured result-set format.
Default: Csv

options.name: --result-file-mode
options.description:
Result output: Write one file or one file per result set.
Default: SingleFile

options.name: --output-encoding
options.description: Result output: .NET encoding name for all routed files; default is UTF-8 with BOM.

options.name: --error-output
options.description: Message/error routing: Initial path for SQL error messages; :Error can replace it.

options.name: --out-behavior
options.description:
Message/error routing: Select whether :Out also redirects normal messages.
Default: ResultSetsOnly

options.name: --var
options.description:
SQLCMD-style variable.
Repeatable.
Examples: -v x=1, -v y "value"
